paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Comparison of trainable parameters between Ex1 and Ex2 in Embedding and LM Head training.
model_annotation: This stacked horizontal bar chart illustrates the distribution of trainable and frozen components for two categories, labeled Ex1 and Ex2. The vertical axis displays the categories, ordered from top to bottom as Ex2 followed by Ex1, without an explicit axis title. There is no standard horizontal value axis with an axis line, tick marks, or numeric intervals; instead, the values are represented by the proportional lengths of the bar segments and are annotated directly onto them as percentages summing to 100 for each bar. Each horizontal bar is stacked with two color-coded components defined by a legend located below the chart: dark purple segments on the left represent "Trainable (%)", and light blue segments on the right represent "Frozen (%)". For the Ex2 category, the dark purple Trainable segment is annotated with a value of 1.29, and the light blue Frozen segment is annotated with 98.71. For the Ex1 category, the Trainable segment is annotated with 3.41, while the Frozen segment is annotated with 96.59. The chart does not follow ascending alphabetical sorting, placing Ex2 above Ex1, and visually emphasizes the specific data points by embedding exact numerical text within the colored segments, using white text for the smaller Trainable portions and dark text for the larger Frozen portions.
